p: root of the righteous shall not: They are so grounded in the favour of God, that their root will prosper continually.
deliver them: As their conscience is upright, so will they be able to speak for themselves against their accusers.
and hath a servant: The poor man that is contemned and yet lives of his own travail.
regardeth the life of his beast: Is merciful, even to the very beast who does him service.
net of evil men: Continually imagines ways to harm others.
root of the righteous yieldeth fruit: Meaning, their heart within, which is upright, and does good to all.
right in his own eyes: He stands in his own conceit, and condemns all others in respect to himself.
a prudent man covereth shame: Who bridles his affections.
a sword: Which seek nothing more then to provoke others to anger.
good word maketh it glad: That is, words of comfort, or a cheerful mind which is declared by his words, rejoices a man, as a covetous mind kills him.
is more excellent than his neighbour: That is, more liberal in giving.
took in hunting: Although he gets much by unlawful means, yet he will not spend it on himself.
